title: fix(ui): Setup's everyone note and header tags speak to an administrator

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuLMXrdNyk1pRovMvtWKFsbH)_

Refs #30208

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：设置里两处给管理员看的文字改成业务说法。权限集分配页，被 everyone 岗位分发的权限集提示从「已绑定到 everyone 锚点 — 所有登录成员都持有此权限集。」改为「所有登录成员都持有此权限集。」；设置列表标题旁的三个标签 管理配置 / 平台架构 / 身份 改为 在此配置 / 平台预置 · 可编辑 / 经身份服务写入（十个语言包同步）。
- 为什么改：#30208 走查第 4、9 行：「everyone 锚点」是岗位机器名加引擎术语，三个标签说的是对象怎么建的，管理员不悬停看提示就不知道意思。
- 风险与回滚：只改前端文案，不加不删词条键，不改标签何时显示（objectui#12194、objectui#13385 的裁决不动），悬停说明文字不变；回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts` 的 `managedByBadge.*.short`、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/components/ManagedByBadge.tsx` 的 `VARIANTS` 英文兜底、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/AssignedUsersSection.tsx` 的 `everyoneNote`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/AssignedUsersSection.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/components/__tests__/ManagedByBadge.keyboard-27521.test.tsx`，预期 22 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Card #30208 is a nine-row walkthrough. This PR ships the two rows whose text `ui/` draws; the other rows are listed under Acceptance notes with their owning lane, so the card stays open.

- **Row 4, permission set assignment.** `AssignedUsersSection`'s `everyoneNote`, shown when the everyone position distributes the set, now reads 「所有登录成员都持有此权限集。」 / "Every signed-in member holds this set." It no longer names the everyone anchor.
- **Row 9, Setup list header tags.** The card offered "remove, or explain". This takes **explain**: the badge stays, drawn under the same rule as before (authoring callers only; Setup record pages carry it on the header chip), and its short label now says what the bucket means for the administrator:

  | bucket | before (zh / en) | after (zh / en) |
  |:--|:--|:--|
  | `config` | 管理配置 / Admin config | 在此配置 / Configured here |
  | `system-data` | 平台架构 / Platform schema | 平台预置 · 可编辑 / Built in · editable |
  | `better-auth` | 身份 / Identity | 经身份服务写入 / Via identity service |

  The same three `short` values change in the ar, de, es, fr, ja, ko, pt and ru packs, so no pack keeps the old meaning. `ManagedByBadge.tsx`'s English fallbacks match `en.ts`. Tooltip titles and bodies are unchanged. No key is added or removed.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/30208-setup-admin-wording.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

Branch: the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-9po7qw`, not `claude/issue-30208-*`; the card is #30208.

## Tests

- `AssignedUsersSection.test.tsx` gains a top-level describe (3 cases) on its existing harness, with the console locale mocked through `./i18n`'s `useMetadataLocale`: zh-CN shows 「所有登录成员都持有此权限集。」 and the section's text has neither 锚点 nor everyone; English shows "Every signed-in member holds this set." with no "anchor"; CONTROL, a set the everyone position does not distribute shows no note.
- `ManagedByBadge.keyboard-27521.test.tsx` gains a top-level describe (3 cases): the zh pack's three tags, the English three, and a CONTROL that `engine-owned` and `append-only` keep 系统管理 and 只读 · 审计日志.
- Positive control: with the four source files restored to the base (`git restore --source=c5800818`) and the new tests kept, 4 failed / 18 passed (the four non-control cases), restored with `git checkout HEAD --` and `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

Rows not shipped here, each with its reason and owning lane, for the seat to split:

- **Row 1** (permission set assignment help: `fail-closed`, 半开区间 [from, until), 智能体授权): the help texts are served from `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/translations/zh-CN.objects.generated.ts` (and plugin-approvals for the same 半开区间 phrase). `domain:server`.
- **Row 2** (new business unit: 图谱语义, Null 表示租户根节点, HRIS, 图谱查询): `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.objects.generated.ts`. `domain:server`.
- **Row 3** (edit organization 「为 true 时…」): the same platform-objects zh-CN bundle, and the pattern recurs on other objects' booleans there. `domain:server`.
- **Row 5** (Settings → 数据生命周期 retention / row quota / class quota as raw JSON): needs a new field control over a settings shape served by `packages/objectql/src/lifecycle/lifecycle-settings.ts`; not a pure `ui/` control over an existing field shape. Needs a spec/settings decision on the shape first.
- **Row 6** (通知偏好 topic/channel free text, 免打扰 JSON) and the comment's 通知模板 topic/channel: `channel` is free text by an earlier ruling (route A on #25346, cited in `packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/notification-preference.object.ts`) because the channel set is open at runtime and a `select` cannot store `*`. A picker reverses that ruling, so it is a decision for the maintainer, not a `ui/` fix. 免打扰 (`quiet_hours`, `Field.json`) needs a new time-range control.
- **Row 7** (队列 / 队列成员 pages in English, 新建Queue): `sys_queue` and `sys_queue_member` are declared in `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing`, which ships no translation bundle at all; the title, columns and help come from its English object metadata. `domain:server`.
- **Row 8** (邮件投递 banner `No mail leaves this machine`, toast `Sent test email to…`): `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/live-transport-status.ts` and `email-plugin.ts`. `domain:server`.
- Seen while taking the screenshots, same class as row 7: on the zh-CN console the Setup sidebar's 人员与组织 / 访问控制 entries contributed by plugin-security (Users, Organization, Business Units, Teams, Invitations, Position Holders, Permission Set Assignment, Sharing Rules, Record Shares, Queues, Queue Members, API Keys) render in English, though `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.ts` carries 「权限集分配」 for `nav_permission_set_assignment`. Visible in the screenshots below. Not measured further, so which side drops the translation (the contributed nav item or the console's nav label lookup) is not established.

## Verification
